note.label: Zionism in the Face of Syria & Hezbollah

precepts.why:
Isaiah says the land would be set “with strange slips”, and Christ says Jerusalem would be “trodden down of the Gentiles.” Ezekiel gives another precept on who those strangers are.

“Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses.” God calls them the worst of the heathen, and they will possess our houses. Those are the Gentiles Christ was speaking about in Luke 21:24, the strange slips planted in our land.

“I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled. Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and there shall be none. Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumour shall be upon rumour.”

That is what we see now. America and Israel fund rebel forces and put a former al-Qaeda commander, Abu Mohammad al-Jolani, once with a ten-million-dollar bounty on his head, in as president of Syria, because Assad said they are not even real Jews and shouldn't be in the land; now Trump shakes his hand in the White House. Israel announces it will occupy southern Lebanon up to the Litani River. Mischief upon mischief and rumour upon rumour: the worst of the heathen possessing the houses of the children of Israel.

note.label: All Skinfolk Ain't Kinfolk: Children of Darkness

precepts.why:
Even in the Israelite nation you have evil ones. “As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty: but they made the images of their abominations and of their detestable things therein: therefore have I set it far from them.” We were sacrificing to idols, worshipping other gods and violating God's laws.

“And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall pollute it.” God gave our land and our sanctuary into the hands of other nations, starting with the Babylonians, and to the wicked of the earth: that is Edom, the European man. “My face will I turn also from them”: you ask for my help and I am not listening. “for the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it.” The robbers are still there; they call themselves Israelis today. Imagine a robber who robs your house and never leaves: he posts up, puts your ass in the basement, and when someone asks whose picture that is of a black man, he says, that's me, I had a tan that day.

“Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.” Make a chain means judgment was established. What is crime? Sin. We became a nation of criminals, and a criminal gets incarcerated; we are still serving our sentence today. Some will stay in prison till it burns, and some will get out on good behaviour, keeping God's commandments. Our cities were full of violence before any white intervention, and we are the answer to our own problems.

“Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses”: the worst of all the nations God made, and we are under him now. He possessed our lands, our people and our identity. “I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease”: we were prideful, sure nothing would happen to us and we would be in the land forever. “Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and there shall be none.” We seek peace, equality and rights, and there is none, because we were rebellious then and we are worse now.

precepts.text: Make a chain, for the land is full of bloody crimes; that is what came upon Jerusalem when this law was not applied among the people.
precepts.point: A lot of people do not know how to apply this verse; the precept for Leviticus 5:1 is Deuteronomy 17:4. Whether the thing be told thee or thou hast heard of it, thou shalt enquire diligently, and only when it be true and the thing certain does judgment proceed: make sure you are certain of a thing before you bring somebody to judgment.

note.label: Leviticus 5: The Trespass Offering and the Duty of the Witness

precepts.why:
This is what came upon Jerusalem when the witness law was not applied among the people. The Lord gave the city “into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil”, turned His face from them, and the robbers entered His secret place and defiled it.

“Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.” A land full of bloody crimes is a land where those who saw and knew did not utter it. When sin among Israel is hidden instead of brought out, the whole city fills with violence and the Most High hands it over.

note.label: SABBATH NOON CLASS: History Repeats Itself - Message From Jeremiah

precepts.why:
Watch how it describes the enemy we were caused to serve: “I will bring the worst of the heathen.” The Bible prophesies that God will bring the worst of the heathen, and this is Esau. “They shall possess their houses”, and “their holy places shall be defiled.”

The laughing barrel shows what the worst of the heathen did. On many plantations slaves were not allowed to laugh; we weren’t even allowed to be seen having fun. Slaves with boisterous personalities, wanting to laugh, often had to stifle their outbursts by the use of the laughing barrel. It was not by choice; this is what they were trained to do on the plantation. Some plantation owners had barrels set up, and when a slave heard something funny he would have to run off to one of those barrels in order to laugh, then go back to whatever he was doing. Some believe that is where the phrase ‘a barrel of laughs’ comes from.

The black house of praise also used shouting barrels when the slaves would steal away at night to church service. The slaves stifled the noises they wanted to make by holding their heads over barrels, sometimes filled with water, to keep the slave patrols and their white plantation owners from hearing them. White people viewed slaves laughing as a form of disrespect to them. Look at this, Esau: the white man viewed slaves laughing as disrespect. This is your good friendly neighborhood white man, four or five generations ago. It was not that long ago.

They don’t teach this in school; you have to find it doing research. It was shown at the Lest We Forget slavery museum, which had a laughing barrel just like it. There is so much history of the slave trade coming out that they did not discuss, and the Edomite teaching the slave trade and cotton in a high school class rushed through that section. This is what Ezekiel talked about when he said, I will bring the worst of the heathen: we weren’t even allowed to laugh.

Christ said the same thing: “they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles”. Trodden down of who? The Gentiles. Christ called them the Gentiles; Ezekiel called them the wicked and strangers. They’re talking about the same thing. “Until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled”: until the times of the Gentiles’ rulership be fulfilled.

Pay attention: he’s going to put a name on them. “Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea”: Idumea, that’s Edom, the Ashkenazi; that’s them. “Which have appointed my land into their possession”: Ezekiel tells you the name of the group that appointed God’s land into their possession.

“With the joy of all their heart”: they are happy to take the land; they are happy to murder other people just to keep the land. “With despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey”: they called their fellow Europeans from Poland, Germany, Czechoslovakia, Uzbekistan, Russia, Italy, Yugoslavia and said, come get some of this land. That’s what they do.

Ezekiel calls those strangers robbers, and so does Daniel. “And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south”: that’s talking about Egypt. “Also the robbers of thy people”: y’all see that? The robbers of thy people, that’s Esau, Edom.

“Shall exalt themselves”: they exalt themselves as the people of God, as the Jews. “To establish the vision”: to establish the vision that they are the Jews, that the land is theirs. “But they shall fall.” God says they shall fall; the Bible prophesies they shall fall, so we ain’t making nothing up.

Nahum to explain the chain. “Yet was she carried away, she went into captivity”: the Israelites went into captivity. “Her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets”: they destroyed our children, killed our children. “And they cast lots for her honourable men”: they bid for us in slavery. “And all her great men were bound in chains.” In what? In chains. So the chain of Ezekiel 7:23 means captivity.

Now what did we do? We like to think we were just such good, righteous and holy people, upstanding citizens of God. That’s a lie. Y’all see how grimy our people is today; as grimy as we are today, we were just as grimy in the past. I know, I know: the white man made us the way we are. Really? Well, let’s read what God said about us.

“For the Lord hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land”: that was us. “Because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land”: we didn’t give a dag on about the Bible. “By swearing”: we used to swear all the time. “And lying”: we used to lie all the time. “And killing”: we used to kill each other all the time. “And stealing”: we used to steal all the time. “And committing adultery”: oh, we committed adultery all the time. “They break out, and blood toucheth blood”: we couldn’t stand one another.

Lying: we have a problem here in the body with lying, a lying lifestyle, and some of you women are going to bear witness to it. Y’all be looking at these people on Instagram and TikTok thinking they have such fabulous lives, and a lot of it is all a lie. I don’t see brothers do that too much, but I see a lot of sisters following these different women; a lot of it is a lie.

Killing: I found a lot on killing, and a lot of it of course is with the brothers, but I didn’t want to get the brothers; I wanted to show you how women do kill too. A woman who killed her two-year-old son because he wouldn’t eat his food, and then said a man attacked her and abducted her son: she’s a liar too. Take a look at her: she is an attractive sister, she’s not ugly. Had she walked through these doors, a lot of you single brothers would have been all over that like white on rice, and you would have got what you got. Everybody ain’t mentally right. That’s what we always tell y’all: wait, let them get their mind right with the word of God. Try them. Find out who her friends are, what the senior sisters say about her, what her counselor says about her; if she got parents, meet her parents; see what background she comes from. Notice it never mentioned a man with her. She’s one of those many women who goes out and has a baby, and then for whatever reason, I don’t care what the reason is, whether he’s no damn good or she just says I don’t love you no more, she’s single. She’s mentally broken; she can’t deal with the responsibility of raising a child, but she can go to the club and Drop It Like It’s Hot. There’s a lot of sisters like that, and some of them come inside. Let them marinate in the scriptures; you better try them in the spirit.

Stealing: some sisters in IUIC are dealing with Edomite men. True story: an Edomite man contacted us and said, I’ve been paying this hoe’s rent for the past year, and showed him and her laying together. Sister, he blew your spot up. And Haitians do steal; I’m going to show you how our people do steal. Never forget, this is Levi. That was in Miami, Florida. Judah is nasty as hell.

Committing adultery: see how her attitude switches from the lying woman, to the take-no-responsibility, to the adulterous spirit. She called him out on his simping: you ain’t going nowhere. That’s her mind, some of their mindset. God can’t use brothers like you. She said, did you forget we put the mortgage in my name; my name is on all the bank accounts. I’ve been telling you brothers, stop putting this woman’s name on everything. We have horror stories in IUIC with so many slick women that watch online; they come in, wait, and look just as pretty for one of you simple sap-sucker simps over there, convince you to put her name on all the bank accounts, then give you the finger and take all you got. Didn’t the sister take thirty grand out of her husband’s bank account and skip town? All I can say is don’t do that. I’m going to be nice, because some sisters are sincere and they’re trying, but you got to wait and see if they’re truly sincere.

“Blood toucheth blood”: a fourteen-year-old shot his sister and his brother over a Christmas gift. Christmas is a burden not to be kept.

King David didn’t go through captivity, but David, who was also a prophet, saw visions of our captivity. “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.” Edom was with the Babylonians, destroying our temple and defiling our land. Ancient Babylon were Africans, Kushites; and when Babylon burned down the temple, Esau was there with them, assisting Babylon.

“O daughter of Babylon”: David calls Edom the daughter of Babylon. “Who art to be destroyed”: that means in the future; their judgment is to be destroyed. “Happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us. Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones”, because that’s what Edom did to us.

So the worst of the heathen that possess our houses and defile our holy places in Ezekiel 7:24 are the same ones who cried ‘rase it’ when Babylon took Jerusalem.

Let’s see, during the time of Babylon, who took the land. Let’s see if the Kushites took the land. Listen to what was asked: “And that all the country which they hold should be free without tribute”, and that the villages of the Jews should be given over, “which then they held.”

So even back then they always wanted our land; they took it from the time of Babylon. Here, during the time of Ezra, in the Persian and Median captivity, the request was: give us back our land that they took. They always wanted our land, and that’s another way we know who the people in our land today are.

A Christian may be saying, that’s not what Jesus said; Jesus never called them the worst of the heathen. For the Christian liars out there, let’s see another word Christ called them: “When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)”. Christ called them the abomination of desolation spoken of by Daniel.

So Christ called the white man, Esau, Edom, the abomination of desolation, and Ezekiel called them the worst of the heathen.

This is where Daniel mentioned it. “And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week”: Rome. Rome had a covenant with the Israelites for one week. “And in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease”: in the midst of that week he stopped the sacrifices that we were giving.

“And for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate”: he made the land of Israel desolate, “even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate.” Abominations, one more time: that is the abomination of desolation Christ spoke of, the same ones Ezekiel calls the worst of the heathen.

“Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds!” This white man devises iniquity and works evil while he sleeps. “When the morning is light, they practise it”: when the sun comes up they begin to practise the evil they thought about. “Because it is in the power of their hand”: they have the technology, brothers, they have the weaponry. That’s what it means.

“And they covet fields, and take them by violence.” Didn’t Christ say the thief comes not but to steal, to kill and to destroy? Didn’t David call them the violent man? Did it say they take it by voting? By violence. How did they take Australia? By violence. How did they get South Africa? By violence. America, Canada, Europe, the land of Israel: by violence. That’s what the Bible says. “And houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.”

Put up the papers from 1948: the Chicago Daily Sun-Times, ‘Its name is Israel, US recognizes Jewish state’; the Palestine Post, ‘State of Israel is born.’ They took our land. Look how evil these people look, and y’all looking for righteousness from these people, want to have children with these people? You got to be kidding me. These are the worst of the heathen that “shall possess their houses.”

Destruction is coming to the land of Israel; they shall seek peace and there shall be no peace. “His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.” Destruction shall be ready at his side.

“It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.” The firstborn of death is Christ. “His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle”: out of his kingdom, “and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.” Christ is the king of terrors.

“That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath.” Do y’all hear that? The wicked is reserved to the day of destruction: that is the destruction that cometh in Ezekiel 7:25.

“Let destruction come upon him at unawares”: destruction is going to come upon him at unawares. “And let his net that he hath hid catch himself”: the traps that this white man set for us and for other nations, they are going to fall into their own trap. “Into that very destruction let him fall.”

“For when they shall say, Peace and safety”: when the white man says peace and safety, “then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.” Sudden destruction is going to come when they think there’s going to be peace on earth. The Lord says, hold on: there’s going to be war, destruction and devastation. They shall seek peace, and there shall be none.

A little more on that. “And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand”: he uses his technology, he uses his political devices. “And he shall magnify himself in his heart”: he magnifies himself in his heart as the Jews, as the people of God.

“And by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes”, against Christ, “but he shall be broken without hand.”

What we want y’all to see is that by peace they shall destroy many. They told the Palestinians, run south and you’ll be safe. The people of Gaza took their wives and children, newborn babies, and ran south, and got bombed to hell. Don’t be shocked, don’t be surprised, and never ever trust your enemies. Then the white man says, oh, it’s Hamas, he’s using you as a human shield.

During the time of ancient Babylon our people sought a vision from the prophet and the priest, but it was not there, because those prophets and priests lied. Now the evil turns on the wicked: “Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth”. Evil is going to come upon this white man in our land, just as it came upon us. “And mischief shall fall upon thee”: mischief upon mischief. “Thou shalt not be able to put it off”: they’re not going to be able to stop it. “And desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, which thou shalt not know.”

“Stand now with thine enchantments”: God is telling the wicked, stand with your witches, your enchantments, “and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth”. Since the white man was young he always laboured and worked with enchantments and sorceries.

“Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee.” God is letting us know they work with witches. “Behold, they shall be as stubble”: they’re going to get burnt up, not only in America but in the land of Israel too. “The fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame”: that’s destruction.

So when the law perishes from the priest and counsel from the ancients, what do they have over there? Stargazers, monthly prognosticators, witches and warlocks, sorcerers.

precepts.why:
“Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes”: this is talking about Israel, the land. “And the city is full of violence”: when we were there our city was full of violence, and this is why we went into slavery.

Now watch what happened as a result: “Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses.” Put them bastards back on the screen; the word mamser means bastards, by the way. Brothers and sisters, I’m not trying to be racist. God said he will bring the worst of the heathen to possess our houses in the land of Israel. God is saying these are the worst; it’s not me saying it, it’s what the Bible says. That look that they have is not our heritage, it’s not biblical.

“I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled”: our holy places have been defiled with these people. But watch what God says: “Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and there shall be none.” There ain’t going to be any.

points: “Thus saith the Lord God unto the land of Israel”. Unto who? The land of Israel. So Ezekiel 7 is about the land of Israel. “The end is come upon the four corners of the land”: the land, the land, the land. Ezekiel 7 is talking about the end of the land.

“As for the beauty of his ornament”: the beauty of God’s ornament was the temple on the land. “But they made the images of their abominations and of their detestable things therein”: that’s what the ancients of Israel did. The very next chapter tells you how the ancients worshipped idols secretly, and the women of Israel were worshipping Tammuz, Nimrod’s son, which the Christmas idea stemmed from. “Therefore have I set it far from them.”

“And I will give it into the hands of the strangers”. What is the it that he will give into the hand of strangers? The land, the land, the land. “For a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil”: he would give the land to the wicked of the earth for a spoil. “And they shall pollute it”: the wicked, the strangers, shall pollute the land.

“They shall pollute my secret place”: the secret place was when they destroyed the temple and the holy of holies. “For the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it”: now it’s calling those strangers, which were the wicked, robbers.
“Make a chain”: we know that means captivity; we would go into captivity. “For the land is full of bloody crimes”: the land of Israel is full of bloody crimes, “and the city is full of violence.”

“Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen”: we can’t run by that line. Look what God calls them. He has called them strangers, he has called them robbers, he has called them the wicked, and now he calls them the worst of the heathen. Put their pictures up, put Amalek on the screen: God calls them the worst of the heathen.

“And they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled.” A Christian will say no, this is talking about when Babylon came and took the land of Israel. Yes, that is true. But remember, the judgments of God are like a ring: they come around again.
So Ezekiel called them the worst of the heathen, and Christ called the white man, Esau, Edom, the abomination of desolation. There are many names the Bible calls them.

“Destruction cometh”: yes, that happened during the time of Babylon, but it also happened during the time of the Greeks, and it also happened during the time of Rome. And guess what, brothers: even during this time, destruction is coming. “And they shall seek peace, and there shall be none.” Destruction is coming to the land of Israel; they shall seek peace and there shall be no peace.

“Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumour shall be upon rumour; then shall they seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the ancients.” During the time of ancient Babylon our people sought a vision from the prophet and the priest, but it was not there, because those prophets and priests lied and lied and lied.
And what do they have over there now? Stargazers, monthly prognosticators, witches and warlocks, sorcerers.

“The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation.” You might ask yourself: during the time of Christ we didn’t have a king of our people. But when Pilate said, ‘Shall I crucify your King?’, what did the Israelites respond? ‘We have no king but Caesar.’ Damn. We said the white man is our king.

So yes, the judgments we’re reading happened during the time of Babylon, they happened during the time of Rome, and guess what is going to happen during this time period. “And the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I am the Lord.”
